verdict.rationale: Manufact is an MCP hosting and deployment platform, so per-end-user credential isolation is a fair question for it. The evidence shows only organization-level API keys for programmatic access and a community comment about OAuth reauthentication. Neither documents per-end-user connected accounts or scoped tokens that restrict each user's agent to that user's credentials.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can maintain separate connected accounts and scoped tokens per end user of my product, so each user's agent acts only on that user's credentials
